-        Downloads: The member can download the network Providers, by county and by insurer, in order to search for a specific provider in an offline mode (no Wi-Fi, no 3G)
-        Pre-Approvals: The member can view the Approvals that are prepared but not yet extracted, by date
-        Approvals History: The member can view his Approvals history, by date
-        Limitations: The member can view the set limitations and exclusions by Benefit based on his Policy
-        Medical File: The member can securely view his medical file and medical history by Diagnosis, 1st & last episode
-   Reimbursement Claims: The member can submit and track his Reimbursement Claims directly through the App, that will automatically list the documents needed per type of reimbursement (In-Patient, Out-Patient, Prescription Medicine, Doctor Consultation)
-        Request for Pre-Approvals: The member can directly submit and track a request for Pre-Approval  to Best Assistance medical team, that in turn will coordinate with the assigned Healthcare Provider and issue the Approval
